name: Job Board by ejobsitesoftware
author: jobboardsoftware

sections.description:
Job Board by ejobsitesoftware is a powerful and flexible job board solution for WordPress. It allows you to create a full-featured job portal with:

  1. Custom Post Types for Jobs – Effortlessly create, manage, and showcase job listings with a dedicated job post type.
  2. Advanced Job Categorization – Organize jobs by categories, countries, and currencies for precise filtering and global reach.
  3. Seamless Login & Registration – Separate Employer and Job Seeker accounts ensure a smooth and secure experience.
  4. Save & Apply for Jobs – Job seekers can save favorite jobs, apply with resumes and cover letters, and track applications in real-time.
  5. Status Tracking for Applications – Stay updated with the status of applied jobs directly from the user dashboard.
  6. Unlimited Job Posting & ATS Support – Employers can post unlimited jobs and manage candidates efficiently with an integrated Applicant Tracking System.
  7. Dedicated Dashboards – Intuitive dashboards for employers and job seekers to manage jobs, applications, and profiles with ease.
  8. AJAX-Powered Job Search – Enjoy fast, dynamic, and filterable job searches without page reloads.
  9. Custom Taxonomies & Easy Integration – Flexible taxonomies for job types and categories, plus shortcodes for seamless embedding anywhere on your site.
  10. All-in-One Job Board Solution – A feature-packed, fully responsive, and easy-to-use solution to run a professional job portal.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Support

For support, please visit https://ejobsitesoftware.com/contact/ or use the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/job-board-by-ejobsitesoftware directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “AYN Job Board” menu in the WordPress admin panel to configure the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
What shortcodes are available?

  • [jobboard_jobs] – Display job listings.
  • [jobboard_post_job] – Show the post job form (for employers).
  • [jobboard_dashboard] – Show the user dashboard.
  • [jobboard_login] – Show the login form.
  • [jobboard_register] – Show the registration form.
  • [employer_dashboard] – Show the employer dashboard.
  • [jobseeker_dashboard] – Show the jobseeker dashboard.
  • [jobboard_apply_form] – Show the job application form.

Can I customize the templates?

Yes, you can override the plugin’s template files in your theme for full customization.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, it works with most modern WordPress themes and page builders (Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, etc.).

Can employers manage their job postings?

Yes, employers get their own dashboard where they can create, edit, and manage job listings.

Can job seekers upload resumes?

Yes, job seekers can upload their resumes while applying for the job.

Does the plugin support job application tracking?

Yes, employers can view and track all job applications submitted by job seekers.

Is there a limit on the number of job postings?

No, you can post unlimited jobs depending on your website hosting capacity.

Can I translate the plugin into my language?

Yes, the plugin is translation-ready and compatible with WPML, Polylang, and other translation plugins.

Does it support custom job categories and job types?

Yes, you can create custom taxonomies for job categories, countires and job types.

Can I restrict job posting only to registered employers?

Yes, only registered employers can post jobs using the job posting form.

Does it integrate with WordPress users?

Yes, the plugin uses the native WordPress user system and creates roles for employers and job seekers.

Will it slow down my site?

No, the plugin is lightweight, optimized, and follows WordPress coding standards for speed and performance.

Can I use it for multiple job boards on the same site?

Yes, you can create multiple job boards using categories or different pages with shortcodes.

Is support available?

Yes, you can get support via the WordPress.org support forum or our website.
